scope: Genuine Rack 2.6.6 Engine.stepBlock host transition proof; no production parity claim until paired actual Engine traces pass.
float_gate: Every serialized raw voltage and parameter exact IEEE-754 binary32 bits, including inactive private output slots; hand anchors exact binary32. No tolerance, warmup exclusion or fitted exceptions.
discrete_gate: Exact keys, identities, event ordering, Engine frame, channel counts, cable counts, bypass, declared source configurations.
anchor_policy: Anchors declared by source reading and hand arithmetic, before any SDK/production execution. Failed anchors are failures, not automatically rewritten.
paired_policy: Identical cases/order and complete snapshots; optional validator --paired file required to claim host equivalence. SDK-only anchors do not establish OpenPatch parity.
system_scope: One thread, cpuMeter false, sample rate 48000, no audio device, GUI or module-process fallback.
